title: Oven-Roasted Slovakian Creme Fraiche Gratin
description: A hearty and comforting Slovakian dish, made with creme fraiche and simmered to perfection, featuring juicy tender vegetables. Enjoy as a diabetic-friendly dinner option on a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes, placing them in a large bowl of cold water to prevent browning.
Mince the garlic and chop the fresh dill. Set aside.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the sliced onions until tender. Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with paper towels. Add the potatoes to the skillet with the onions and garlic, stirring to combine.
In a separate mixing bowl, combine the crème fraîche and chopped fresh dill, stirring to combine.
Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Spread half of the potato mixture in the prepared baking dish, then top with half of the crème fraîche mixture, and finally sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Repeat the layering, starting with the remaining potatoes, then the remaining crème fraîche mixture, and finally sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh dill, if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days.
Freeze for up to 2 months, thawing overnight in the refrigerator before reheating.
